公司目前主要生產地區包含越南 、 印尼 、 柬

主要競爭對手：

本次報告：電話訪談

聚陽 (1477 TT) 
最壞情況已過，接單表現應逐步回升

永豐觀點 
原油價格維持高檔，地緣政治風險仍存，造成品牌商下單信心保守，考量客戶庫存
水位已低，拉貨力道有望逐步回溫，聚陽營運谷底應已過，評價有望逐步好轉，研
究部對聚陽營運看法維持正向。 
 投資評價與建議 
投資建議維持買進，目標價 258 元：受原物料價格高漲及戰爭影響，客戶下單態
度趨於保守，考量目前客戶庫存水位已低，公司最壞情況應已過，隨著戰爭及原物
料等風險因素解除，聚陽客戶下單信心有望逐步恢復， 惟短期客戶仍未進入補庫存
循環 ， 將抑制聚陽獲利成長動能 ， 預估公司2026/2027 稅後 EPS 15.77/17.18 元，
公司過去四年股利配發率皆達 99%以上，以此推估公司 2027 年配息，殖利率應
達 8%以上，具備殖利率保護，目前本益比處於歷史區間近最下緣，考量公司營運
谷底已過，評價應逐步回升，給予本益比15X，目標價258 元，投資建議維持買進。

ESG 評析 
聚陽企業永續評鑑整體為 B+等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向平
均得分分別為 B 等與 A 等。

聚陽為亞太地區知名成衣製造商：公司設立於 1990 年，主要業務包括成衣設計、
製造與銷售，主要原料包括主料（本布）及副料（拉鍊等），以向國內外知名廠商
下單為主。公司目前主要生產地區包含越南、印尼、柬埔寨、中國、孟加拉、薩爾
瓦多，2025 年公司主要客戶營收比重：GAP 占 36%，T arget占 18%，日系客戶
占 18%，Dick′s Sporting goods 占 9%，Kohl′s 占 7%，其他占 12%。 
3Q26 獲利預期季增：聚陽 8 月營收 35.6 億元(+18.5% MoM，-5.1% YoY)，符
合預期。聚陽 8M26 出貨量-12% YoY，價持平 YoY，匯率影響+7% YoY。展望
3Q26，受戰爭及通膨因素影響，客戶下單態度趨於保守，提高短交期訂單比重，
聚陽 3Q26 短單比重提升至 15%，出貨量預期年增約中個位數，ASP 受產品組合
影響而預期年減約 3%，研究部預估聚陽 3Q26 營收 96.4 億元，（+18.1％QoQ，
+8.5％ YoY） ，預估毛利率24.03%，（+0.16 pts. QoQ，+2.12 pts. YoY） ，預估
稅後淨利 10.5 億元（+18.1％ QoQ，+8.5％ YoY） ，稅後EPS 4.26 元。 
獲利表現穩健，維持買進投資建議：展望後市，客戶下單仍趨於保守，聚陽 4Q26
短交期訂單比重預期將達 15-20%，預期 4Q26 出貨量將年增低個位數，ASP 因
公司挑單生產及因應原物料報價調漲 ， 預期將年增5-7%， 取決於短交期訂單比重 。
公司計畫於 2027 年持續擴增印尼及孟加拉產能，2027 年聚陽整體產能預期將年
增約 7-8%，若客戶補庫存力道較預期積極，則有望提升至雙位數以上增長。研究
部評估聚陽受到原物料價格高漲及戰爭影響， 客戶下單態度趨於保守， 聚陽短單比
重已由先前約 10%提升至 15%，考量目前客戶庫存水位已低，公司最壞情況應已
過，隨著戰爭及原物料等風險因素解除，聚陽客戶下單信心有望逐步恢復，惟短期
客戶仍未進入補庫存循環，將抑制聚陽獲利成長動能。綜合以上，研究部預估公司
2026 年營收 356.1 億元（+3.4％ YoY），毛利率 25.39%，稅後淨利 38.9 億元
（+7.6％YoY） ，稅後EPS 15.77 元。預估公司 2027 年營收 384.7 億元（+8.0％ 
YoY） ，毛利率25.46%，稅後淨利 42.4 億元 （+9.0％YoY） ，稅後EPS 17.18 元，
公司過去四年股利配發率皆達 99%以上，以此推估公司 2027 年配息，殖利率應
達 8%以上，具備殖利率保護，聚陽目前本益比處於歷史區間近最下緣，考量公司
營運谷底已過，評價應逐步回升，給予本益比 15X，目標價 258 元，投資建議維
持買進。

營 運 分 析

台達電為全球電源管理及散熱解決方案領導廠商 
台達電(2308)成立於 1971 年並於 1988 年掛牌上市，成立初期分別投入生產
交換式電源供應器與無碳刷式直流風扇，目 前已取得全球電源產品龍頭地
位。2017 年公司啟動組織調整，以「電源及零組件」、「自動化」、「基礎
設施」、「交通」四大業務範疇，並從傳統關鍵零組件製造商逐步轉型為節
能解決方案提供者。近年隨AI 資料中心建置需求爆發，公司積極將既有電源
技術延伸至 AI伺服器電源機櫃、液冷 side car、BBU、DC-DC/AC-DC模組
及 CDU 等新產品線，目前終端應用已從傳統 NB/工業電源、資料中心跨足
至高壓供電(HVDC)與液冷散熱系統，客戶涵蓋NVIDIA與北美 CSP及 ASIC
供應鏈。

26Q2 營收比重:(1)電源及零組件 53%,包含電源、被動元件等零組件、風扇
散熱;(2)交通 5%,電動車解決方案;(3)自動化 8%,包含工業自動化,樓宇自動
化;(4)基礎設施 34%,包含資訊通訊技術(通信電源、網通交換器、資料中心
解決方案、液冷side car)、能源基礎設施(電動車充電樁、可再生能源及儲能
設備等)。受惠 AI 資料中心電源需求與規格持續提升，台達持續擴充台灣、
中國大陸、泰國與美國產能，並同步推進 800V HVDC 架構開發，全面迎接
NVIDIA 新世代 GPU 機櫃功耗大幅提升所帶動的電源與散熱升級需求。

個股報告

缺料影響營運不如預期，下修 Q3獲利預估，EPS 9 元 
台達電(2308)公告 8月營收：營收 645.9 億元，MoM -3.7%/YoY +34.9%，
Q3達成率 62.4%，低於研究部預期與市場共識，係因 MOSFET 全產品線呈
現缺料所致，故研究部下修台達電 26Q3 營收 1960.8 億元(原估 2,107.4 億
元)，QoQ +7.0%/YoY +30.4%，而先前 18.3KW PSU 因電容問題有進行產
品召回，不過預期本月將處理完畢且對財務無任何影響；毛利率方面，受惠
產品組合轉佳與規模經濟抵銷原料/電子元件漲價影響，預估毛利率 35.8%，
仍可維持與上季相當，季增 0.2ppt，反映營收下修，同步下修稅後淨利 232.6
億元，QoQ -7.5%/YoY +25.0%，EPS 9元(原估 10.5 元)。

AI 電源與散熱產品持續放量，輔以新產品推出，2026 EPS 37元 
展望 2026 年，主要成長動能仍來自 AI 資料中心電源、散熱與基礎設施，在
電源方面隨著 GB300 持續放量與 H2 VR200之 18.3KW 產品開始出貨，預
期價量齊揚挹注營運動能，此外 HVDC(±400V/800V)產品於 3Q26 開始量
產，惟在初期階段預期僅小幅貢獻；在散熱產品方面(涵蓋水冷板、Manifold、
CDU及 Sidecar)在 2026 下半年可望延續成長動能，主要受惠液冷滲透率持
續提升與內容價值同步墊高。綜上所述，反映 Q3下修，同步下修台達電 2026
年營運預估：2026 年營收 7,465.4 億元，YoY +34.5%，毛利率 36.2%，年
增 1.9ppt，稅後淨利 960.8 億元，YoY +59.8%，EPS 37.0元（原估 40 元）。

HVDC滲透率提升，且持續海內外擴產，2027年營收挑戰超越 1兆元，EPS 
62.3元 
展望 2027 年，受惠 CSP業者 CAPEX 持續增長，公司為滿足訂單需求，持
續加大投資力道，2026 年資本支出約 700 億元(YoY +50%)，資金來源除自
有資金外，9/15 公告發行泰達電可交換公司債籌措 15 億美元以滿足擴產資
金需求，2027 年也可望維持高檔水準，預計於泰國、中國、台灣與美國同步
擴產，研究部認為 HVDC(±400V/800V)較大規模量產貢獻有望於 2027 年起
顯現，同時液冷、電源機櫃、DC-DC模組等新產品線持續放量，此外公司亦
持續推進 SST 與 SOFC 等能源基礎設施長期布局，電源產業將迎來新格局
與長期成長動能。兆豐投顧預估台達電 2027 年營收 1.1 兆元，YoY +43.0%，
毛利率 37%，年增 0.8ppt，稅後淨利 1617.6 億元，YoY +68.4%，EPS 62.3
元。

### Page 6

Aspeed Technology (5274.TWO)
09 September 2026 Citi Research
6
Aspeed Technology
Company description
Established in 2004 and listed in 2013, Aspeed is a leading IC design
company based in Taiwan focusing on baseboard management controller
(BMC) solutions. Aspeed started the business by targeting datacenter
servers/white-box markets and has been working closely with server ODMs.
Following the acquisition of Emulex Pilot from AVGO/Broadcom in 2016,

Aspeed successfully expanded its product lines, IP pool as well as customer
base and became the largest BMC supplier with c.70% of global market share.
Other than BMC, Aspeed is also broadening its product portfolio by including
bridge IC (BIC; or mini-BMC), platform firmware resilience (PFR) solutions and
input/output (I/O) expander, aiming to maximize the dollar content it could
generate per server motherboard.
Investment strategy
We rate Aspeed shares a Buy. As a leading BMC supplier with c.70%+ global

market share, it has been riding the strong momentum underpinned by a
recovery of general-purpose servers and upticks in AI servers. We expect the
growth to continue. Apart from being in a dominant position for the supply of
upcoming GB200 server BMCs with higher dollar content and better capex
efficiency, new product launches including AST2700, PFR, I/O expander and
Cupola 360, as well as steady growth in general-purpose servers should also
act as key drivers for the company.

Valuation
We value Aspeed at NT$25,000 based on a historical mid-cycle multiple
(since 2020) of 50x 2028E EPS, as we believe it fairly reflects the company’s
earnings performance and industry dynamics, secular growth trends, and
Aspeed’s strong supply chain position, as well as robust earnings growth
amid margin expansions.
Risks
Our quant rating system rates the Aspeed stock High Risk based on its
volatility over the past year, which we think is unwarranted given the

company's dominance and outlook in the BMC sector. Key downside risks to
our earnings forecasts and target price include: 1) weaker-than-expected
growth in servers; 2) slower-than-expected CPU platform migration; 3) peer
competition; and 4) limited progress in product diversification.
Prepared for Kevin Lu

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

### Page 1

Taiwan Industrials

What’s new: Eternal Precision Mechanics (EPM) reported its August 2026 
revenue after market hours on 9 September 2026.

What’s the impact: August revenue beat expectations. EPM reported 
August 2026 revenue of TWD359.8m, up 95.7% MoM and 111.5% YoY. 
QTD revenue reached 88.4% of our previous 3Q26 forecast and 74.2% of 
the Bloomberg consensus. Given the faster-than-expected revenue 
recognition schedule and a sharp increase in recognised high-end 
equipment units, which should drive a more favourable product mix, we 
raise our 3Q26 revenue forecast by 33% to TWD972.7m, gross margin by 
3.1ppts to 48.5%, and EPS by 92% to TWD1.86.

Vacuum laminators are emerging as the next ABF bottleneck. Despite 
a partial conversion of backlog into revenue in August, EPM’s backlog 
continued to increase from TWD810m at end-July to TWD880m in early 
September. With lead times extending further to 36 months, vacuum 
laminators are emerging as the next bottleneck in the ABF capacity 
expansion cycle. Given the robust demand from ABF substrate makers, we 
see upside potential to EPM’s capacity expansion plans. On margins, we 
expect continued product-mix improvement and the full realisation of price 
increases to lift gross margin by 6.6ppts/1.3ppts YoY to 53.2%/54.5% in 
2027/28E, driving a 2026-28E EPS CAGR of 141%.

Moulding film adoption opens a new growth avenue. Traditional 
transfer and compression moulding typically use granular, powder, or liquid-
type compounds for encapsulation. During our visit to SEMICON, Japanese 
material suppliers Nagase (8012 JP, JPY1,150.5, Outperform [2]; covered 
by Masayuki Nagano) and Resonac (4004 JP, JPY16,070, Outperform [2]; 
covered by Hidemitsu Umebayashi) noted growing customer interest in 
moulding films. These offer better filling performance, better warpage 
control and higher flowability. This makes them increasingly suitable for 
advanced packaging applications such as panel level packaging and 
component-embedded substrates. EPM supplies moulding-film laminators 
for both applications, with revenue contribution expected to begin in 2027.

What we recommend: We lift our 2026-28E EPS by 22-26% to reflect the 
full realisation of price increases and improving product mix. We reaffirm 
our Buy (1) rating and raise our 12-month TP to TWD720 (from TWD600) 
based on an unchanged target PER of 40x, applied to our 1-year forward 
EPS forecast. Key downside risk: slower-than-expected substrate capex 
growth.

How we differ: We likely conduct a more comprehensive analysis than 
others on ABF industry demand and moulding film development.

9 September 2026

Vacuum laminators: the next ABF bottleneck

➢ 3Q26 QTD revenue ahead on higher high-end equipment recognition 
➢ Product mix and price hikes drive margins to new highs 
➢ Reaffirming Buy (1) rating; lifting 12M TP to TWD720

Company profile 
Eternal was established in 2022 through the spin-off of Eternal Material’s equipment division and its 
subsequent merger with Nikko-Materials, a wholly owned Japanese subsidiary. The company was listed 
in January 2026 and is the global leader in IC substrate vacuum laminators, serving all major substrate 
manufacturers worldwide.

AI semi capex, in particular for compute chips, should outgrow
overall AI capex in 2028. We add cross-checks on ASICs after
AVGO’s guidance and the Qualcomm/AWS AI ASIC
announcement.
Will 2028 be another growth year for AI semis? Our US internet analyst Brian
Nowak published the Morgan Stanley AI Guidebook: Navigating the Age of
Inference, and suggests 12% CSP capex growth into 2028, raising investor questions
about AI semi growth momentum. Based on our latest supply chain checks, we

introduce preliminary 2028 CoWoS/CoPoS/EMIB-T capacity assumptions. In
aggregate, we still see 50% capacity growth in 2028 (see Exhibit 1), implying
flattish infrastructure (e.g., the shell and AI DC) spending and moderate memory
pricing in 2028.
Larger chip size and more applications (CPU, networking) to drive further
growth in 2028: All these packaging technologies are 2.5D (compute and memory
chips on side to side) for AI/HPC chips, including AI GPU, XPU, CPU, and networking.

•CoWoS (wafer based): We still see some CoW expansion at TSMC. For oS, TSMC
may need more partners than ASE. Our checks suggest both Amkor and Xintec
(non-covered) will diversify oS production in the US and Taiwan, respectively.
• CoPoS (panel-based): This is a panel-level process. After converting to 12-inch
CoWoS wafer equivalents, we assume 5–10kwpm in 2028. The initial target project
should be Nvidia’s Feynman Ultra GPU.
• EMIB-T (substrate-based): Although a substrate-based technology, we convert it

to 12-inch CoWoS wafer-equivalent capacity as well. One EMIB-T substrate can
generate 16 pcs of a 9x reticle-size chip, around 4x the chips a CoWoS wafer can
generate. Our checks indicate ~40k–45k wafer-equivalent EMIB-T capacity in 2028,
producing at least 2mn of Humufish (9x reticle) substrates. 40k–45k wafer
equivalents also imply 10-15% share in 2.5D packaging.
Read-across from recent ASIC guidance at Broadcom and the Qualcomm/AWS
partnership

•According to Joe Moore’s report: Broadcom Inc.: Earnings solid; raising FY 28 EPS,
more specific FY27 revenue guidance is now US$115 bn, and that could double again
in FY28. Our CoWoS supply-chain checks already see an AVGO AI lab customer
booking ~15k–30k CoWoS wafers for 2027.
•Qualcomm announced its ASIC partnership with AWS, a key Alchip ASIC customer.
However, the press release points to inference, different from Alchip’s Trainium4,
which covers both training and inference. We therefore see limited impact to Alchip.

TSMC CoWoS and CoPoS
With continual booming demand in AI, we expect TSMC and its OSAT partners to expedite
capacity expansion plans for CoWoS. We expect TSMC's CoWoS capacity to further build
to 260kwpm in 2028 from 130/200kwpm in 2026/2027, with 2028's expansion mainly

focusing in Arizona's AP9/10 and potentially in AP7. TSMC is now conducting trial
production for CoPoS in Taoyuan. As long as the progress goes well, we expect TSMC to
start building its CoPoS capacity, with the location also likely to be in AP9/10 or AP7P3.
We expect the non-TSMC camp to expand CoWoS capacity to 110kwpm by 2028 year-end
from 80kwpm by end-2027. For ASE/SPIL, we expect FoCoS+CoWoS capacity to rise from
30kwpm at 2027-end to 50-60kwpm at 2028-end, with expansion focused on CoWoS-L

and CoWoS-R. For Amkor, we expect CoWoS capacity to increase from 30kwpm at 2027-
end to 55-60kwpm at 2028-end, also focused on CoWoS-L and CoWoS-R.

• AMD's total 2027 CoWoS consumption increases 165% Y/Y to 345k:

reach around 500-650k units respectively. We estimate total TSMC CoWoS-L
booking increases 200% Y/Y in 2027, to 210k.

estimates.
We expect Luxshare, Lingyi, Crystal, and AAC to be the key
beneficiaries of the new iPhone launch. We downgrade Largan
to EW and Genius to UW.  Both can benefit from the variable
aperture lens upgrade, but enthusiasm over Co-Packaged Optics

has made the stocks overvalued.
The iPhone opportunity is real for Largan and Genius…but their stocks have
rallied 48% and 85%, respectively, in the past month: (The TAIEX is up 5% over
this period.)
We now value Largan at NT$7,100/share – no longer attractive: Our analysis
suggests that Largan's current share price already embeds more than 30% global
market share in Fiber Array Units (FAU) before formal production starts in 2H27 or
even 2028. Our residual income model yields a value of NT$3,000/share for the

company's traditional business, while our TAM analysis derives a value of NT$4,100/
share for CPO/FAU new business, bringing the total price target to NT$7,100.
However, any delay in CPO/FAU development poses significant downside risk. We
therefore downgrade to EW.
We now value Genius at NT$910/share – but  even on this basis, we view it as
overvalued: Similarly, we believe Genius's share price is also inflated by hopes for
FAU components. Using a similar approach, we conclude that aggregate value is NT

$910/share (NT$600 for existing business and NT$310/share for FAU component
business). We recommend taking profits.
Reiterate OW on Luxshare, Lingyi, Crystal and AAC: We believe all four companies
will benefit from the new iPhone launch. Here, however,  we still see upside in the
stocks. We see these companies, benefiting in various ways:
• Luxshare: Key player in iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max assembly, also benefits from
variable aperture upgrade as component supplier.

•  Lingyi: Higher content value form both iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max and foldable.
•  Crystal: Micro prism modules, coated filters, and cover lenses should enjoy
positive ASP and volume growth.
• AAC: Vapor chamber (VC) heat dissipation upgrade for iPhone 18 Pro Max
and Pro is the key catalyst.
Remain EW on Sunny Optical and GoerTek: Sunny is a key variable aperture
component vendor, but it's been well on track to meet the goal of doubling revenue,
implying limited upside surprise. GoerTek could face labor shortages and margin

communications with a subject company, public appearances
and trading securities held by a research analyst account.

Implications from iPhone 18 Launch for Various Supply
Chain Companies
Camera spec upgrade is a positive earnings driver, but CPO
enthusiasm has made Largan and Genius overvalued
The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have applied a variable aperture main camera for the first
time, representing a significant hardware upgrade.  The ASP of  variable aperture lenses will
be higher than it is for traditional lenses. Thus, a rapid shipment increase in 3Q26 could

become a key re-rating catalyst – indeed, it has already prompted sharp re-rating for
Largan, Genius, and Sunny.
Besides this, the launch of Apple's first foldable iPhone will also provide an incremental
demand driver beyond the standard iPhone 18 lineup. According to Nikkei Asia (link),
foldable smartphone orders increased from 8 million units to 10 million units this year,
and if the new product performs well in 4Q2026, it could become a positive catalyst for

Apple supply chain companies.
Beyond variable aperture and foldable, the further development of a new periscope lens
with the key customer is likely to expand  these use of periscope lenses in the future. This
could also become a positive driver for optical lens companies in the supply chain.
1. Largan: iPhone opportunity is real, but recent enthusiasm
over CPO made valuation too aggressive – downgrade to EW
Largan's revenue follows a well-established seasonal pattern tied to Apple's annual iPhone

launch cycle. After shipments declined continuously from March 2026 through June 2026,
we expect a seasonal recovery to begin in 3Q26, with sequential increases highly likely in
the following months. Largan's August 2026 consolidated revenue reached NT$5.012
billion, up 3% month-over-month and its best performance in four months, and the
company expects September's shipment momentum to surpass August's.
Largan is a key supplier of variable aperture lenses for the iPhone 18 Pro series, and the

company could also benefit from foldable and periscope opportunities, we raise our
intrinsic value estimate of the company's traditional business from NT$2,814/share to NT
$3,000/share. For more details, please refer to Exhibit 18.
Besides the Apple lens opportunity, we believe Largan's share performance is also highly
correlated to CPO development. In order to assess the fundamental value from the CPO
opportunity, we undertook the following analysis:

1. We forecast CPO optical engine volume to increase from 0.39mn in 2026 to
7.78mn in 2027,with a further surge to 48.6mn in 2028. Consequently, FAU (Fiber
Array Units – vital optical interconnect components that align multiple optical
fibers with silicon chips, making them critical for Co-Packaged Optics) volume for
CPO also grows from 0.39 to 48.6 mn for the same period of time;
2. We assume ASP of US$100 in 2026-2028 (average market level);
3. We forecast Largan's FAU market share to increase from 0% in 2026 to 5% in

### Page 6

2027 and 40% in 2028 (previously 20%).
4. Assuming net margins of 10% in 2027 and 30% in 2028, we forecast FAU earnings
of US$4mn in 2027 and US$579 mn in 2028.
If we value the FAU business at 35x 2028e P/E (industry peers are at 40-50x P/E, and
considering the first year of scalable production), it could bring incremental market cap of
US$20.278bn. Discounting it back to 2026 at a 10% rate, we derive a per-share positive
impact of NT$4,100.

We hold a positive view on Largan's CPO/FAU business opportunity because the company
has a superior track record of high precision manufacturing relative to most industry peers
in Taiwan. However, our calculation above suggests that the current share price already
reflects Largan's potential  to attain >30% global market share for FAU products.
Meanwhile, formal production hasn't kicked off yet – it is more likely to start in the

second half of 2027 or even 2028. Therefore, any delay in CPO/FAU development could
result in significant share price fluctuation. Considering current risk-reward, even after
raising our price target 47%, we no longer view Largan as attractive any more in view of
the recent strong share price performance. We set our price target at NT$7,100, within
which NT$3,000 is from its traditional business and NT$4,100 is from CPO/FAU new
business.

3. Sunny: Apple revenue to double in 2026, but positive is
well known
We believe Sunny Optical will benefit from the new iPhone launch because:
1. The company is a key vendor of  variable aperture actuators – a key spec upgrade

with higher ASP.
2. Sunny is expanding the product mix from a single category to multiple categories,
which could generate higher revenue from the key client.
3. Sunny is also gaining share in high-end lens products.
These drivers collectively underpin management's guidance of doubling  Apple revenue for
the full-year of 2026.
However, the fundamental performance is in line with management's guidance, so there is
lack of potential positive surprise, in our view. We therefore raise our net income

4. Crystal: Prisms, coated filters, and cover lenses to benefit
We expect Crystal Optech to benefit from Apple's new product launch because  the
company is supplying three key products in the supply chain:
1. Its micro prism modules are a key enabling component for periscope (folded-

optics) telephoto cameras in smartphones. The company's prism technology uses a
folded optical path to achieve long-focal-length telephoto capability without
increasing device thickness. In 1H26, the micro prism module business enjoyed
significant volume growth. The iPhone 18 launch will directly extend this demand
into 2H26.
2. Crystal-Optech's coated filter business — which brings micro-nano optical
processing into the IRCF manufacturing process to significantly improve petal

ghosting and chromatic aberration in special imaging scenarios — is another key
segment that benefits from the iPhone 18 launch. Apple's high-end Pro models are
the primary application for this product, so the company is highly likely to
generate rapid revenue and earnings growth.
3. The iPhone 18 Pro models are expected to feature advances in 3D sensing,
including a smaller Dynamic Island as some Face ID components move beneath the
display, which sustains demand for these optical components. Crystal Optech is

well positioned to capture the growth opportunity in iPhone's 3D sensing and
cover lenses.
The company's 2Q26 results were a bit weaker than we expected because of rising costs
from R&D and capacity expansion related to new products. However, we believe this
investment could lead to stronger growth in 2028 and onward. As a result, we trim our
earnings estimates 15.6% for 2026 and 2.9% for 2027 but raise our 2028 estimate 8.2%.
Consequently, we raise our price target  7%, to Rmb32, implying 24% upside from the

current level.

We believe Luxshare's Apple opportunity is underappreciated –  some investors worry
about the supply chain relocation. However, the company is one of Apple's most deeply

We expect Luxshare to benefit from the latest new product  launch through the following

four key drivers:
1.  Second largest assembler for iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max — the most premium-heavy
iPhone lineup in history. If the  Pro/Pro Max models can take 70%+ of total iPhone
volume, it could mark the highest high-end model contribution over the past
several model cycles. A higher share from high-end models implies better revenue
and margin outlook for Luxshare.
2.   Capturing component opportunity in new  variable aperture actuator supply.

Instead of doing assembly, Lxushare is also playing the role  of supplier of actuator
mechanisms for the variable aperture camera system in the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro
Max. This helps Luxshare gain exposure to high-end component business, which
carries higher margin than assembly business.
3. Foldable iPhone (iPhone Ultra) exposure: While Luxshare is not the assembler for
the foldable phone, it has actively developed foldable hinge technology, with R&D

focused on high-precision, long-life, large-angle hinge modules for inward-folding
flexible-display devices. The company is also developing ultra-thin haptic motors
tailored for foldable smartphones. When foldable shipments reach a certain scale,
Luxshare is also highly likely to become the second assembler.
4.  Leading AirPods assembly share:  In the AirPods assembly market, we expect
Luxshare to remain the largest supplier, with GoerTek as the second player. The

iPhone 18 launch is accompanied by new AirPods models, and Luxshare's dominant
AirPods assembly position means that it captures the full breadth of Apple's 2H26
product cycle — not just the iPhone.
Despite a significant FX loss, Luxshare posted resilient earnings in 1H26. We nudge our
EPS estimates up 0.2% each for 2026 and 2027 and 2.0% for 2028 to reflect the solid
1H26 results and positive growth outlook in the following 2-3 years. As a result, we also

raise our H-share price target to HK$82/share, implying 34% upside potential.
Lingyi: Peak season to drive strong earnings improvement
Lingyi  provides a broad range of components, including core precision parts, hinge
precision structural components, screen support plates, flanged ultra-thin stainless steel
battery case modules, etc. Following the launch of iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and Apple's
first-ever foldable iPhone, Lingyi is likely to benefit from  higher content per unit on

standard Pro models, and a step-change in content value from the foldable iPhone.

foldable device expected by the company to reach US$80–90, including titanium inner
hinges, hinge components, and mid-frame support structures — substantially above the
content value of conventional smartphones.

Considering the positive drivers in 3Q26, we expect Lingyi to achieve significant earnings
improvement on a QoQ basis, which could become a key re-rating catalyst.

because the revision is minor while our long-term RI model assumptions remain

AAC: Key beneficiary of  iPhone VC application
AAC Tech is one of Apple's key component suppliers, providing a broad portfolio spanning
acoustics, haptics, and thermal management. The iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max and iPhone Ultra
launch is a direct, multi-dimensional catalyst across all those business segments.
Within the three segments, we believe thermal management –  Vapor Chamber (VC) Heat
Dissipation – is the most important catalyst. AAC Technologies is a key vendor of VC heat

spreaders in the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. The significant expansion of the VC cooling
area is driven by the iPhone 18 Pro's A20 Pro chip, which debuts on a 2nm process node
with complex WMCM packaging technology to support on-device AI computation, leading
to increased thermal output. Apple first introduced VC liquid cooling in the iPhone 17 Pro
series, with AAC as the primary supplier for that generation as well.
This division has already demonstrated significant growth momentum heading into the

iPhone 18 ramp up. In 1H26, heat dissipation revenue surged approximately 400% YoY, to
RMB1.10 billion, primarily driven by the continued ramp-up in shipments of high-
performance innovative vapor chambers. The company expects VC shipments to exceed
180,000k units in 2026, up from 140,000k+  units in 2025.

maintain our OW rating.
BYDE: Normal peak season, but lackluster with limited spec
upgrade

### Page 12

M
Idea
12
While Apple is BYDE's key customer, accounting for >50% of total revenue, it is mainly
from the  iPad assembly business. Therefore, this division is less likely to benefit from the
iPhone 18 launch.
The company is also the second-largest iPhone metal casing vendor, supplying precision
structural components including titanium and aluminium alloy chassis. While iPhone 18
launch is the direct driver for this segment, the titanium-to-aluminium downgrade has

become a near-term headwind.  Titanium is a higher-value, higher-margin material for BYDE
while aluminium carries lower ASP and lower gross margin. This change has made BYDE
less likely to benefit from the iPhone 18 launch.
Despite the lackluster outlook, we expect earnings to show sequential improvement in
3Q26, driven by the normal peak season in 3Q26, followed by stronger growth in 4Q26 as
liquid cooling products for AI infrastructure also ramp up. Our earnings estimates and

price target remain unchanged.
GoerTek: Margin might face pressures despite peak season
GoerTek's primary Apple exposure is in smart acoustic complete units (AirPods assembly
and components) and precision components. We believe the  iPhone 18 launch and peak
season ramp in 3Q–4Q will drive higher shipment volumes for these products.
However, GoerTek's transfer of production  to Vietnam — where it has invested
approximately US$1.3 billion through multiple entities — has created a persistent labor

cost headwind. In 2H25, a labor shortage caused by the rapid capacity transfer forced
GoerTek to offer higher wages, triggering material  gross margin pressure  for the smart
acoustic assembly business. Overall gross margins partially recovered to 13.8% in 1Q26
and 15.2% in 2Q26, but the underlying trend of rising wages in Vietnam remains a
structural factor. As GoerTek ramps production for the iPhone 18 peak season in 3Q and
4Q, the higher labor cost base in Vietnam will continue to weigh on assembly margins.

We raise our 2026 and 2027 earnings estimates 14.9% and 10.6%, respectively, mainly
reflecting the better-than-expected gross margin recovery in 1H26. However, we raise our
price target only modestly: 4%. to Rmb27, as persistent labor-cost pressure in Vietnam
could limit further margin expansion and reduce the earnings benefit from higher peak-
season volumes.
Considering the factors discussed above, we believe GoerTek is less likely to benefit from

the new iPhone product launch and peak season volume increase.

Where we could be wrong
While we expect iPhone 18 to be  a positive catalyst in 2H26, we are watching three key
variables on the potential inflection points:
1.  Memory prices: These are a key variable this year. If there is a memory price
correction anytime during 2026, investors are likely to expect an earlier
smartphone shipment and margin recovery, which could reverse the negative

sentiment.
2.  LLMs: We see LLMs as a revolutionary innovation. They could introduce numerous
creative features in smartphone applications and change user habits in the years to
come. If the Edge AI breakthrough arrives earlier than we expect, it could
accelerate the smartphone product cycle and make the recovery earlier.
3. iPhone sales performance: Better-than-expected sell-through of the iPhone 18
Pro, Pro Max and its first foldable model could drive shipment upside, higher

content value and stronger capacity utilization. Conversely, weaker demand could
lead to order cuts after the initial ramp up and reduce the earnings benefits from
key hardware upgrades.

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.

USI (601231.SS): ELSFP reinforces our confidence in USI’s optical roadmap.
EugenLight, USI’s photonics subsidiary, showcase its external laser source modules
(ELSFP) during CIOE. We believe EugenLight’s solution stands out on power

efficiency, 8 channel ELSFP around 12W, which should become increasingly
important as optical I/O scales and system-level power constraints tighten. More
importantly, we see ELSFP as a strategically important building block for the
migration toward NPO and ultimately CPO, where moving the laser source outside
the compute/package environment can improve overall system reliability. While
USI’s optical-module business has so far ramped below our earlier expectations

(link), our CIOE discussions suggest that the company has not fallen behind in
ELSFP , giving it another route to participate as architectures evolve beyond
conventional pluggables. Customer design in and production ramp are key things to
watch going forward.
ASMPT (0522.HK): Fluxless TCB addresses two key challenges in optical engine
packaging. Our key takeaway from CIOE is that optical engine  packaging faces two
critical manufacturing challenges – warpage and optical-port contamination –  both

of which could become more pronounced as OEs scale in size and complexity.
Compared with conventional mass reflow, thermo-compression bonding (TCB)
offers better control over the bonding process and can help mitigate warpage,
potentially improving assembly yield and reliability. Meanwhile, ASMPT’s fluxless
TCB solution, enabled by AOR (Atmospheric Oxide Removal), eliminates the need
for flux during bonding, thereby avoiding flux residue and reducing the risk of

contamination at sensitive optical ports. We believe these process advantages make
TCB particularly well suited for next-generation optical engine packaging and
strengthen ASMPT’s positioning as NPO/CPO architectures scale. (Continued)

Takeaways from other booths: Laser chip capacity expansion and higher power CW 
products were key themes, with Source Photonics outlining significant EML and CW 
capacity expansion for 2027, with its 200mW CW products targeted to support NPO in 
1Q27. Source Photonics also demonstrated an ELSFP for 6.4T application using its in-
house  CW lasers, with 8 outputs delivering ~112mW per channel. Yunling displayed 
200mW and 300mW chips, HiSilicon showcased a 400mW device, and Everbright 
launched a 400mW-at-50°C CW DFB chip. We believe customer qualification and 
sustained volume delivery remain key differentiators as product availability broadens. 
NPO optical-engine bandwidth is progressing from 3.2T to 6.4T, with exhibits from Source 
Photonics and Accelink, and to 7.2T in HiSilicon's integrated-light-source design. VCSEL 
also remains an active NPO route for short-reach applications with HiSilicon displaying a 
3.2T VCSEL NPO. 
Conference takeaways: Tencent outlined a roadmap targeting the deployment of a 512-
acceleratotor supernode using 3.2T NPO in 1Q27, followed by a feasibility assessment in 
2Q27. Alibaba's roadmap targeted 4Q26 mass production of 3.2T NPO modules and 
QFabric switches followed by 6.4T UPO production around mid-2027. Its 6.4T UPO, 
developed with Accelink, is set to be demonstrated at the Sep 2026 Apsara conference.  
Tencent and Alibaba highlighted scale-up as a key near-term opportunity for NPO, citing its 
balance of bandwidth density, power consumption, supplier openness and delivery 
readiness. Industry participants also argued that NPO could remain a viable long-term 
architecture rather than a transitional one. For scale out, pluggables may remain the 
favored solution for broad deployment by some industry participants. Huawei's roadmap 
has progressed from 50G VCSEL solution in its 384-accelerator A3 supernode to 100G 
VCSEL LPO solution for its A5 supernode up to 8,192 accelerators. HiSilicon showcased 
both 3.2T VCSEL NPO and 7.2T SiPh NPO with integrated CW sources as potential future 
architectures.

Document 096: 260914_gs_optical-tour

Source PDF: all report pdf/260914_gs_optical-tour.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-09-14
Pages: 9
Status: ok

### Page 1

1. Optical module demand outlook: Companies we visited remain positive on 
optical module demand, driven by AI server racks ramp up, optical module adoption 
expansion (from scale out to scale up / across), and specification upgrade. On global 
market demand on 800G and 1.6T, demand could be at 130m to 200m; for the China 
market, overall demand could also grow at mid double digits to 50m+ units, with the 
majority 800G and 400G, and 1.6T emerging. Nevertheless, companies we visited 
with also mentioned that tight raw material supply (e.g. DSP , lasers, PCB) could 
continue to cap shipments in 2027. The positive tone echoes our positive view on 
global demand, on which we raised 800G and above optical module demand by 39% 
/ 36% in 2027E / 2028E to 144m / 171m (report link). Supply chain positive tone 
reflects further upside to our estimates. 
2. Optical module competition: Companies we visited see pricing competition 
remaining healthy, with 800G optical module pricing decline within single digits in 
2027, and 1.6T optical module price to sustain at US$700+. Managements highlight 
that optical module is not a pure assembly but with multiple SKUs and require 
suppliers’ strong R&D and timely development as compared to telecom, the product 
cycle could shorten to 1-2 years in datacom vs. 5 years in telecom. Supply chain 
management and mass production capability are also important to win orders, 
especially under the current tight supply situation and clients’ requirements of 
diversifying production sites under geopolitical tension. Innolight, as the global 
leader works with supply chain closely, including R&D collaboration, invests directly 
in their suppliers, and pre-payment and long-term agreements to secure a

### Page 2

sustainable supply through cycles.
3. Laser supply: Chinese suppliers are ramping up capacity and capability in 200G EML,
supporting the 1.6T optical module ramp up in 2027. Nevertheless, shipment also
depends on other raw material supply (e.g. DSP), and customers penetration.
Everbright‘s laser capacity prepared for 2027 is EML slightly higher than CW laser, and
within the EML majority is for 100G, with the remaining for 200G; Dongshan Precision

highlights their 200G EML is already in mass production, while volume is still small
currently given the tight supply of DSP; nevertheless, the company also secured 10m
supply of DSP in 2027, supporting their lasers and optical modules shipment ramp up.
VPEC, global leading InP epiwafer supplier, also sees improving InP substrate supply, with
steady export permission from China government, more customers bringing InP
substrate, and growing second to fourth suppliers outside of China. VPEC’s MOCVD is

also in expansion, from current 62 MOCVD to 69 MOCVD by 2Q27, and planning a new
production site in 2027.
4. CPO timeline: As a new technology, CPO will naturally take time and could face
challenges in the path of commercialization. For example, laser suppliers see thermal
challenges for 300mW / 400mW CW lasers in ELS (external laser source), and is working
on 100mW+ with PA for NPO first. Optical module suppliers also see strong 3.2T NPO
optical engine demand across China and overseas markets. Nevertheless, equipment

suppliers remain the earliest beneficiary in CPO, with the strong testing and coupling
demand reflecting in equipment suppliers’ revenues in mid 2026. For example,
Robotechnik 2Q26 revenues were up 172% QoQ, or 141% higher than our estimates. As
we highlighted in Sep (report link), we estimate CPO switch at 10k / 92k / 131k units in
2026E-28E.
5. AI spending sustainability: Management highlighted that AI is a revolution, and we
are at an early stage of infrastructure spending and application development. It will be a

long cycle for the coming 10 to 20 years, and some of their customers are planning
beyond 2030. The demand for the coming 2 to 5 years remains very strong and
management highlighted their industry enjoys short return on investment, which is
around 1 to 2 years. Management highlighted the AI spending is not only building more
AI data centers, but also includes technology migration, such as making power
consumption more efficient, making data transmission faster, etc., driving the supply

chain growth. Compared to the internet bubble in the 2000s, management sees much
more transparency between end-customers (demand) and supply chain (supply), as end
customers are involved more in supply chain product development and capacity
investment, reducing the information gap between demand and supply, and reducing
the chance of double booking. Management noted that currently every module they
produce is being deployed in data centers, reflecting real demand.

6. Photonics IC scaling up: AI drives data transmission speed and bandwidth
requirement, leading to strong demand on Photonics IC, requesting it to catch up
Electrical IC automated production and testing ecosystem in 1 to 2 years, while EIC /
semiconductors has been developed for decades. The strong demand brings
opportunities to tool suppliers, across coupling and testing, which are necessary tools to
accelerate PIC production. Robotechnik / FiconTEC describes the number of tools they

target to ship in the coming 1 year would be over 50% of what they’ve shipped in the
past 25 years, reflecting the strong demand and orders visibility.
14 September 2026   2
Goldman SachsFor the exclusive use of KEVINLU@LENOVO.COM
e92c7a75ab8b4efbba794e6b187208c8

### Page 3

7. Testing - CPO earliest beneficiary: As a new technology, CPO naturally takes time
and faces challenges in the path of commercialization; however, we identify testing
equipment suppliers as the earliest beneficiaries, considering the expensive final module
means multiple testing during the production process is necessary, given the earlier a
failure is found, the lower cost a failure is. As a result, companies we visited continue to
see Insertion 2 (double-sided wafer-level testing) as necessary, and Robotechnik /

FiconTEC launched the new generation in 3Q26, which fully complied with the global
leading foundry’s communication infrastructure.
8. Testing - shortening time with KGD (know good die) at early stage: To facilitate
photonics IC scaling up, not only are more tools needed but better tools, requiring
suppliers’ strong R&D and execution, delivering continuous specification upgrade.
Robotechnik / FiconTEC, as global leaders in PIC testing, aim to shorten the wafer-level

testing time by 50-60% next year, and target 4x faster die-level testing next year.
Enlitech (7728.TWO, Not Covered) offers NightJar, a hyperspectral image system,
revealing AWG (arrayed waveguide grating) optical loss pathways with absolute optical
power mapping, allowing customers to KGD at Insertion 1 (PIC wafer testing) or Insertion
0 (PIC wafer early defect screening), saving failure costs.
9. Coupling - automated production becoming necessary in high-speed connection:

AI drives optical module towards high speed and high density / bandwidth, driving
demand on automated production. GMT (4573.TWO, not covered) showcased dual FA
active alignment equipment for 1.6T optical module, which could do the coupling for
both Tx and Rx simultaneously, saving 50% of coupling time compared to traditional
equipment. FitTech (6706.TW, not covered) has showcased an optical engine assembly
system, featuring passive / active alignment and customized development of coupling

algorithms, which could be used in multiple products: high-speed optical modules, ELS,
OCS, NPO, CPO, SiPh and optical chiplets. ASMPT has showcased MEGA multi-chip
bonding solution for complex multi-chip and photonics packaging applications,
combining high-precision placement with adhesive dispensing, UV fixation and 3D
inspection in one platform.
10. FAU & Laser specification upgrade: With optical networking expanding from scale
out to scale up, FAU and laser specification is also migrating. FOCI‘s FAU in 2026 to be

mainly 40 channels (starting in 3Q26) for 3.2T, followed by 80 channels (within 2026) for
6.4T, and 100 channels under R&D, per management. The company’s FAU enjoys several
customers across fabless, foundry, laser suppliers, etc. FOCI Aug revenues accelerated to
+20% MoM (vs. +9% MoM in Jul), reflecting the ramp up of high-end FAU. VPEC‘s
optoelectronics revenues enjoy strong growth on the back of strong CW lasers demand
and InP substrate supply getting better. Its InP epiwafer for CW lasers is also migrating

from 70mW / 100mW (scale out) to above 100mW (scale up, NPO) and 300mW /
400mW (scale up, CPO), along with expansion from CW lasers to 100G / 200G EML,
supporting its growth ahead.
14 September 2026   3
Goldman SachsFor the exclusive use of KEVINLU@LENOVO.COM
e92c7a75ab8b4efbba794e6b187208c8

### Page 4

Price Target Risks and Methodology - Zhongji Innolight Co.
Valuation: Our 12-m TP for Innolight A-share of Rmb2,645 is based on 35.6x 2027E P/E,
and our 12-m TP for Innolight H-share of HK$3,267 is based on a H-A premium of 13%.
We derive our target P/E multiple from the networking peers’ trading P/E vs.
forward-year fundamentals (NI YoY and OPM). Compared to Innolight’s historical trading
range, the target multiple reflects our view of its leading market position in high-speed

connections and product-mix upgrade toward SiPh optical modules, driving GM
expansion. We are Buy rated.
Key downside risks: 1) slower-/worse-than-expected 800G+ optical modules demand;
2) slower/worse-than-expected new optical devices ramp pace; 3)
faster-than-expected market share normalizing in 800G+ optical modules; 4)
geopolitical risks; and 5) worsening component supply situation to constrain shipment
growth.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - VPEC

Valuation: We adopt a discounted P/E method and apply a 22.2x target P/E on VPEC’s
2029E EPS, discounting back to 2027E at a COE of 10.5% (beta 1.7x, risk free rate 1.6%
and market risk premium at 5.1%), to derive our 12m TP of NT$793. Our target P/E is
based on a 0.4x PEG&M ratio derived from the average level of peers in the photonics
supply chain.
Key risk: Slower-than-expected SiPh business ramp up; weaker-than-expected
microelectronics demand from smartphones clients; IDM offers EPI wafer in-house.

Price Target Risks and Methodology - RoboTechnik
Valuation: Our 12-month target price of Rmb796 is based on a 20.7x 2031E P/E,
discounted back to 2027E at a COE of 11.3%. Our target multiple is derived from the
correlation between consumer electronic peers’ PEG&M (2026E P/E to 2027E NI YoY and
OPM), with RoboTechnik’s 2032E net income at 2% YoY and 2032E OPM at 32%.
Key downside risks: Fiercer-than-expected market competition; lower-than-expected

optical connection end demand; worse-than-expected photovoltaic market downcycle.
Valuation: Our 12-month target price of NT$833 is based on a 15.4x 2030E P/E,
discounted back to 2027E at a COE of 12.6%. Our target multiple is derived from peers’
correlation between forward-year trading P/E and earnings growth.
Key downside risks: Fiercer-than-expected market competition, technology migration
trends in optical networking, and slower-than-expected capacity ramp-up.

Price target methodology and risks - ASMPT
Valuation methodology: We are Neutral rated on ASMPT with a 12-month target price
of HK$177, which is based on a 24.9x 2030E discounted P/E (discounted back to 2027E).
Our target P/E is derived from correlation between peers P/E to the sum of NI YoY and
OPM.
Key upside/downside risks: 1) customers’ faster-/slower-than-expected adoption of
Advanced Packaging tools; 2) stronger-/weaker-than-expected demand from

automotive customers; and 3) stronger-/weaker-than-expected demand for traditional
IC packaging and SMT equipment.

Global Research
First Read
Delta Electronics
Add to APAC Key Call Buy - Taiwan Summit
reaffirms the AI Power opportunity
Capturing a robust industry TAM as the leading server power supplier
Delta affirmed a stronger growth profile as AI infrastructure now is over 50% of sales.
Our bottom-up model from our APAC Focus (link) estimates a 69% CAGR to US$91.1bn
AI server power TAM from 2025-2030 even moderating 2028-30 for hyperscale cash

flow and grid power constraints. We see a strong 2027 driven by +65% YoY accelerator
die growth, Rubin's ~60% higher rack power and AMD's move to rack-scale systems.
400V/800V becomes a larger driver in 2028-29 as rising power density outgrows low-
voltage distribution. We believe Delta is key beneficiary with its  broad grid-to-chip
portfolio helping sustain its ~40% share of a rising TAM.
Near-term supply constraints bottoming from Aug and accelerating into Q4.

Supply constraints on Power ICs have tempered Q3 growth from +15-20% QoQ to +10-
12% QoQ but should grow in Sep and accelerate to double digit QoQ in Q426 and
above seasonal Q127 (UBS +3% QoQ) into new ASIC/GPU platform ramps and more
supply. Management expects shortages to persist for at least the next several quarters
with demand accelerating faster than supply and the supply-demand gap likely
widening before narrowing but price hikes rebounding OpMs.

HVDC Adoption Appears Increasingly Inevitable.
HVDC production and shipments have begun and should be modest in 2027 before
ramping sharper in the following 1-2 years. As rack power rises from 140kW on GB300
to nearly 250kW on VR200 and potentially higher on Rubin Ultra, management expects
space and efficiency constraints to shift power systems out of racks and into side-car or
centralized architectures. Delta sees HVDC as the logical solution for power-loss,

thermal, and density challenges, with higher-voltage architectures offering multiple-
times higher value per watt than current solutions. Delta sees three hyperscalers
evaluating 400V, two adopting it for NVIDIA racks initially before converging on 800V.
Reiterate Buy and PT NT$2,750
Delta's stock has pulled back 36% since May following push-outs to NVIDIA's
architecture slowing the dedicated power rack ramp-up and elevating supply
constraints, pulling it back to 22x/17x 2026-27 EPS. We now see better entry with sales

ramping in H226, spec upgrades to ASIC power racks and Rubin at 60% higher TDP over
Blackwell and margins holding better than feared. The company should leverage its
strong product line, R&D and field support to participate in the key power architecture
transitions in the coming years moving the power stack out of the rack and also
developing emerging nascent technologies including SST for facility level power
transformation and rectification and fuel cells licensing Ceres for medium-term

opportunity to supplement the power grid constraint with alternative energy.

Company Description
Delta Electronics provides computer switching power supply solutions, as well as video display
and electronics components, for computers, smartphones, telecom and industrial products.
Founded in 1971, the firm has production bases in Taiwan, China, Thailand and India. In

2023, its power electronics, infrastructure and automation segments contributed 62%, 25%
and 13% of revenue, respectively.
UBS EPS and Consensus EPS
The UBS EPS is an adjusted diluted EPS metric. It is calculated using the UBS analyst's
interpretation of earnings suitable for valuation purposes divided by the diluted number of
shares. This may differ to the way the consensus EPS metric has been calculated.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We base our price target on PE multiple valuation.

Delta's businesses include SPS and components for a variety of end-applications, video
displays and data networking subsystem and system products. Any changes in these end-
markets could affect our forecasts for Delta. Investment risk could increase/decrease on any
deviation from our expectations for end-market demand and competition.
Downside risks for Delta include: severe supply chain constraints; weaker-than-expected PC/
server demand; a slower-than-expected IA recovery; and a slower ramp of 5G in 2022.

Global Research
First Read
Novatek Microelectronics Corp.
2026 Taiwan Summit: PC weakness offset by
continued momentum from major U.S. customer
Q3 revenue still expected to grow 5-6% QoQ despite weaker notebook demand
Novatek attended our 2026 Taiwan Summit on Sep 14th. It reiterates Q326 revenue to
grow  5-6% QoQ, supported by seasonal strength in S/M-sized DDI driven by the iPhone
ramp. SoC revenue is expected to grow slightly QoQ, while LDDI should decline

modestly as TV demand remains flattish and PC demand weakens. Importantly,
management highlights notebook PC has seen a meaningful downward adjustment
recently. While the company had originally expected NB shipments to decline  slightly
QoQ, demand has deteriorated to over 10% decline QoQ, with the impact becoming
visible since mid-August. Nevertheless, Q326F guidance for TV, tablet and automotive
remains unchanged. Looking into Q426, management expects seasonal weakness to

continue, with softer memory-driven ASP increases and lower shipment volume likely
resulting in sequential revenue decline.
GM likely peaked in Q226 and should normalize into H226 and 2027
Management highlighted that Q226 GM expanded to 42% from 39% in Q126, mainly
driven by  favourable product mix and lower-cost of  inventory for memory. Looking
ahead, GM is expected to decline QoQ in Q326F as the inventory benefit disappears and
growth shifts toward S/M-sized DDI and LDDI, which carry lower margins than SoC.

Management expects Q426 GM to further contract QoQ, driven by less favourable mix
and softer memory-driven ASP increases. Further out, memory, foundry and OSAT costs
are expected to continue rising into 2027. While Novatek expects to pass through most
cost increases, management acknowledged that the degree and timing of pass-through
will depend on the  negotiation with its customers.
Major US customer remains the key growth driver for 2027-28
The company reiterated strong visibility from its major U.S. customer and expects

revenue to further grow in 2027. Following entry into iPhone DDI programs in 2024 and
subsequent share gains in 2025-26, Novatek expects to continue benefiting from rising
market share as new iPhone models proliferate. Into 2027-28F,  iPhone-related growth
should moderate as the revenue base becomes larger, while management expects
increasing contribution from  premium LCD panels for Macs, supported by a more visible
roadmap. Beyond the U.S. customer, image SoC remains a bright spot due to strong

surveillance demand and emerging Edge AI applications, although management
acknowledged recent growth rates are unlikely to be sustained.
Valuation: Maintain NEUTRAL with price target of NT$540
We retain NEUTRAL with PT of NT$540. While we continue to expect GM normalization
in H226E and 2027E, we believe its GM should sustain at the high-30% level, rather
than  returning to pre-COVID's low-30%.

Company Description
Novatek is a IC design company spun off from UMC's commercial product division in 1997.
The company is focusing on the analog and mixed signal IC design and leads in the display
driver IC and TV SoC market.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value Novatek using a PE methodology.

Upside risks include stronger-than-expected demand for the consumer electronics end-
market, as well as higher market share for OLED DDI.
Downside risks include a weaker-than-expected technology end-market demand recovery
and slower-than-expected inventory digestion.

Global Research
First Read
Powertech T echnology
2026 T aiwan Summit: FOPLP to see more
revenue contribution from 2027F
FOPLP business supported by AMD and Broadcom
PTI attended our T aiwan Summit on Sep 14th. Management noted its  FOPLP capacity in
T aiwan will be at 6K substrate/month (3K in 2026 and add another 3K in 2027 with full
ramp in 2028) with panel substrate size of 510 mm x 515 mm. Management noted  most
of the capacity in T aiwan is allocated to AMD, which it will start from the  game-console

products and then target to enter server CPU. For the Broadcom business, PTI has
previously announced a JV with Broadcom in Singapore, where it will invest US$400mn
into the JV for 30% stake, after receiving regulatory approvals in Q426. The JV will focus
on Broadcom's next generation networking products and will help it to enter into optical
communication field.  It has not disclosed the total investment amount and planned
capacity for the Singapore JV fab, but we believe the planned capacity  could be 2-3x

versus its scale in T aiwan. The JV is expected to start mass production from 2028 and PTI
will be in charged of the fab operations. Nevertheless, PTI also acknowledges that
TSMC's CoPoS will not only lead to potential competition, but could  also have some
impact on the equipment supply schedule.
Memory-backed price hike should continue
PTI's August sales of NT$8,558mn was up 3.5% MoM and 24.5% YoY. QTD sales is
tracking to 69%/68% of UBSe/Street estimates of +5%/+6% QoQ. Management noted

its  back-end loading is already at 90% and it has been selective on customer programs
for better ASP products. Management also expects back-end ASP should continue to
increase, driven primarily by higher labor costs and rising component prices. At the same
time, the pressure to lower its ASPs and  share the profit from yield improvement has
eased. Relative to peers, PTI noted it has been less aggressive in implementing price
increases, but has increased the frequency of price negotiation with its customer. As a

result, its gross margin for  memory packaging and test should continue to trend higher
in the coming quarters.
Capex will remain elevated in 2026-27F
Management reiterate its 2026F capex guidance of NT$50bn and believes its capex in
2027F will remain elevated. It aims to use its internal cash flow and bank loans to
support the capex, and remains committed to keep its  dividend payout at ~60%. Full
year  revenue for 2026F is likely to surpass its prior peak in 2022 (i.e. NT$83.9bn),

although it believes  market expectation of NT$100bn in 2026E could be too stretched.
Valuation: Retain NEUTRAL with PT of NT$260
We retain NEUTRAL on PTI with PT of NT$260, based on 17x 2027 PE. We will continue
to monitor its progress on FOPLP/CPO and price improvement sustainability.

### Page 1

Greater China Technology Hardware
Asia Pacific
Industry View In-Line
What’s new? EMC (2383.TW) shares fell 7.7% and TUC (6274.TWO) shares declined
6.7% on Sep 17, vs TAIEX +0.8%. Following the sell-off, investors have questioned
whether CPO could disrupt demand for high-end CCL. The concern is that
integrating optical engines alongside the ASIC on the package substrate shortens
high-speed electrical signal paths that would otherwise traverse the printed circuit

board (PCB), potentially reducing the need for ultra-low-Dk/Df, high-speed CCL.
Our thoughts:  This is not a new debate. We previously discussed the potential
implications of CPO for high-speed CCL demand here and here.  We believe this is
particularly relevant for scale-up architectures, where CPO adoption still faces
meaningful challenges related to cost, manufacturing yield, reliability, serviceability,
and thermal management. As such, we believe the risk of a broad-based reduction in

CCL requirements across AI systems before 2028 remains limited.  We would view
CPO-driven pullbacks in CCL stocks as potential opportunities to accumulate.
Morgan Stanley does and seeks to do business with
companies covered in Morgan Stanley Research. As a result,
investors should be aware that the firm may have a conflict of
interest that could affect the objectivity of Morgan Stanley
Research. Investors should consider Morgan Stanley
Research as only a single factor in making their investment

communications with a subject company, public appearances
and trading securities held by a research analyst account.
Key Takeaways
Co-packaged optics (CPO) is a long-term risk, not an imminent demand
disruption.
While we agree that broader CPO adoption represents a credible longer-term risk
to premium copper-clad laminate (CCL) content, we see limited risk to the
demand outlook over 2026–28.
We see limited near-term impact on CCL demand or our earnings estimates for

EMC and TUC, leaving our premium-CCL supply-tightness thesis and constructive
fundamental view intact.

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.
Unless otherwise specified, the time frame for price targets included in Morgan Stanley Research is 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

2H26 先進製程動能延續、ABU 復甦，展望正向 
預期 3Q26 大客戶先進製程需求維持強勁、SBU、DBU 新增產能且達滿載，
ABU 受惠傳產機械/工具機業需求回溫及部份產品調漲價格等，預期營收季
增 8%、毛利率在產品組合好轉、規模經濟效益下，估計季增 0.5~1 個百分
點達 40.7%、EPS 3.83 元/季增 10%。展望 4Q26 延續先進製程需求強勁，
其中鑽石碟營收逐月新高，SBU 優化產品組合及特殊晶圓佔比提升而估計毛
利率趨勢向上，推估營收季增 1%、EPS 3.96 元/季增 3%。 
先進製程有助產品內容價值提升，趨勢有利 
2Q26 ABU 、DBU、SBU 營收佔比分別為 25%、31%、43%，其中鑽石碟
來自最大客戶先進製程佔比已達 63%，N3/N2 佔比皆為 22%，並且 1.4nm
小量出貨，對鑽石碟、再生晶圓的內容價值，包括 N2 對 N3 CMP 內容價值
升 10~15%，尤其 A16 CMP 道數由 55 提升至 77 道，內容價值進一步提升
至 2~3 成。再生晶圓 N3/N2 每投片 10 萬片對再生晶圓需求約 2~3 倍，趨勢
有利後續營運。延伸 ABU、DBU 技術，公司亦投入減薄砂輪研發，主要因
應大客戶先進封裝/晶背供電、本土化策略等需求，有機會突破 Disco 壟斷局
面，惟目前仍為產品驗證階段，短期效益不大。 
DBU、SBU 供不應求，訂單能見度至 2030 年 
DBU 目前規劃產能年底至 7 萬顆，根據大客戶 N2/先進封裝產能倍增，加上
來自美系記憶體/IDM 廠潛在需求，預計 27 年產能達 9~10 萬片，中長期目
標>20 萬片。SBU 擴產提前至 2Q26 達 40 萬片滿載，新增以高階再生晶圓
為主，有助毛利率改善。 ABU 來自傳產/工具機需求回溫及子公司合併綜效，
使得營收成長>2 成、毛利率達 25%水準。元大最新預估 2026/27 年 EPS 分
別為 14.23/20.85 元，上修 7%/11%，基於近幾季毛利率表現優於預期，主
要來自產品組合改善，包括先進製程佔比提升、再生晶圓產能擴充且以高階
產品為主及 ABU 復甦及等，使得毛利率優於我們先前預估 2~3 個百分點。 
元大觀點 
⧫  
預期 2H26 DBU 成長維持強勁、 SBU 新增產能效益、 ABU 需求回
溫，營收、毛利率趨勢向上。 
⧫  
展望 2026~27 年隨著主力客戶擴大 N3/N2 產能及海外廠佈局，推升鑽
石碟、再生晶圓供不應求，搭配新產能，營運具更佳的槓桿效應。 
⧫  
預估 2026/27 年 EPS 14.23/20.85 元，分別上修 7%/11%。維持買進
評等，40 倍目標本益比、2027 年 EPS 評價基礎、反映先進製程展望
佳、能見度達未來 2~3 年及佈局減薄砂輪為下一個觀察重點。

延伸 ABU、DBU 技術，公司亦投入減薄砂輪研發，主要因應大客戶先進封裝/晶背供電、本土化策

DBU 目前規劃產能年底至 7 萬顆，根據大客戶 N2/先進封裝產能倍增，加上來自美系記憶體/IDM

併綜效，使 得營收成 長 >2 成、毛利率達 25%水 準。元大最新 預估 2026/27 年 EPS 分別為
14.23/20.85 元，上修 7%/11%，基於近幾季毛利率表現優於預期，主要來自產品組合改善，包括
先進製程佔比提升、再生晶圓產能擴充且以高階產品為主及 ABU 復甦及等，使得毛利率優於我們
先前預估 2~3 個百分點。 
傳統砂輪製造跨足至半導體製程及晶圓再生產業 
中砂原為專業的砂輪製造廠，近年由於傳統產業轉型之需要，轉往從事衍生性鑽石製品的研發創新
及進行企業改造，並跨足高科技晶圓再生產業，公司優勢在於客製化，因為自有切割設備，可以做
非標準厚度的晶圓，相較而言，國際大廠很難因為少量訂單做規格更改。目前中砂在再生晶圓及鑽
石碟業務方面取得了顯著的成績，市占率分別達 15-20%及 20-25%，為該領域的全球領先者之一。

資料來源：公司資料、元大投顧 資料來源：公司資料、Bloomberg、元大投顧 
晶圓代工客戶 3nm 製程產能提升帶動鑽石碟銷售增加 
中砂在鑽石碟技術已取得顯著進展，過去中砂在 5nm 製程的產品市佔率低於 5 成，但進到 3nm 製
程後市占率提升至 7 成，超越國際大廠 3M，整體產品已能夠在中砂完成各式測試後交貨給客戶，
大幅提升產品品質、效率，滿足客戶需求。目前隨台積電 3nm 製程產能逐步增加，預估中砂鑽石
碟出貨量將隨之成長。未來中砂在台積電 N2 鑽石碟供貨比將有望拉升至 8 成以上，技術優勢逐漸
顯現，且製程進入 2nm 後，對於鑽石碟所要求的品質提高、消耗量增加，先進製程鑽石碟內涵價
值平均增加約 5-10%、且用量也會增加，將對中砂鑽石碟產品的價量有正面影響，帶動其鑽石碟業
務之動能。

晶背供電帶動鑽石碟、再生晶圓內容價值進一步提升，IDM 具成長潛力 
為了達到晶背供電的技術，晶圓薄化為關鍵角色，需將晶圓打磨到足夠薄之後，才可實現對電晶體
直接供電，此舉將會使 CMP 需求提升，先進製程鑽石碟市占率極高的中砂為潛在受惠者。 
中砂之大客戶先進製程持續往 N3/N2 推進，CMP 研磨層數更為增加，對鑽石碟規格要求提升及使
用量亦增加，估計 N3 轉 N2 對公司鑽石碟的內容價值提升約 1-2 成，亦使得公司在大客戶供應比
持續提升，過往公司在 N5 鑽石碟對台積電供應比<5 成，N3 提升至 7 成，預期 N2 將達 8 成，已
開始小量出貨。除了台積電以外，Intel 目前多款鑽石碟在驗證中。

特殊晶圓取得進展，已開始出貨記憶體客戶 
承載晶圓(Carrier Wafer) 為一種高度客製化的特殊晶圓產品，主要用途為在晶圓減薄的製程中，須
有承載晶圓暫時貼合進行薄晶圓之支撐，而在製程之後須將承載晶圓移除並將殘膠清除乾淨。中砂
之特殊晶圓與客戶合作多年，已看到美系記憶體客戶承載晶圓需求增加，目前營收歸類在 12 吋測
試晶圓類別，為測試晶圓中毛利最佳之產品，預期下半年需求逐步增加，並且明年出貨量展望更佳。
由於晶背供電需要將晶圓薄化，將使用承載晶圓作為載體，預估隨著各大先進晶圓代工廠進入 2 
nm 製程，將推升特殊晶圓的需求，中砂將具有潛在受惠機會。

### Page 5

請參閱末頁之免責宣言。 台灣：半導體設備與耗材 2026 年 9 月 17 日 Kinik 第5 頁，共 16頁  
中砂研發晶圓減薄砂輪，或將打破日商壟斷僵局 
中砂積極投入晶圓減薄砂輪（包含 Z1 與 Z3 規格）之研發，主要係配合台積電對半導體關鍵耗材
本土化與分散供應鏈風險的戰略需求。目前主要晶圓代工公司半導體晶圓減薄磨削砂輪市場長期由
日本龍頭廠商 Disco 高度壟斷，中砂正積極投入前段研發與後段先進封裝推動高頻率上機測試，展
現出打破外商獨佔壟斷的潛力。該產品若順利打入關鍵供應鏈，具備高毛利率與顯著的市場成長空
間，惟現階段整體進度仍處於客戶產品驗證、製程調校及料號建置階段。由於台積電對新材料導入
之評估程序極為嚴謹且時程具滾動式變數，實際量產出貨時點仍須視最終測試數據與客戶正式下單
而定，因此短期內對公司營收與獲利的實質效益仍待後續持續觀察。

先進製程演進大幅增加再生晶圓用量，成長力道優於整體矽晶圓產業 
隨先進製程推進，製程容錯空間縮小，監控頻率相應提高，正片生產所需之再生晶圓比例持續提升，
製程越先進其量產所需的檔控片數量越多，N65 每投入 10 萬片正片約需要 6 萬片擋控片，但 N3
需求量則大幅增加至 22 萬片，N2 製程用量則更將進一步提升至約 26-27 萬片，故預期未來正片生
產所需之再生晶圓由 20-25%逐步提升至 25-30%。 
再生晶圓除受惠原矽晶圓 需求增加動能外，更可望受惠整體製程往前推進所帶動之測試晶圓需求，
我們認為再生晶圓成長力道將超越整體矽晶圓產業。根據 QYResearch 預估，預計 2029 年全球再
生晶圓市場規模將達到約 20 億美元，未來幾年年複合增長率達 11.5%。

### Page 8

請參閱末頁之免責宣言。 台灣：半導體設備與耗材 2026 年 9 月 17 日 Kinik 第8 頁，共 16頁  
製程微縮大幅增加 CMP 步驟道數，帶動鑽石碟及 CMP 耗材用量提升 
CMP 製程在研磨機台中的研磨墊上方注入研磨液進行研磨，目的是將晶圓上的介電層 (Oxide Layer)
與金屬層(Metal Layer) 磨平，為了接下來的高解析度的微影製程，使晶圓全面平坦化以達到高品質
的多層佈線，同時降低缺陷密度，使製程良率得以提升達到量產水準。 
在矽晶圓進行 CMP 製程時，會將晶圓倒蓋在拋光墊上，鑽石碟在旁邊做修整的動作，功用為清理
旁邊研磨下來的材料，以避免二次刮傷，另外因為研磨過程中溫度會上升，因此研磨墊會出現變質
層，鑽石碟能夠將變質層研磨掉，使其保持研磨的品質，並延長拋光墊的壽命。  
隨製程不斷微縮，CMP 為新電晶體構造與新封裝型態的重要製程，從 45nm 節點需求的十多層佈
線，加倍至 7nm 節點的二十多層佈線。長期來看，隨製程持續微縮化，品質要求日漸提高， CMP
步驟數將提升，且每個機台對於研磨用到的化學品或零組件要求都有 客製化趨勢的需求，將使打磨
/研磨平坦化產值提升，帶動 CMP 設備與耗材需求增加。

資料來源：機械工業網、元大投顧 資料來源：公司資料、元大投顧 
晶背供電將線路轉移至晶圓背面，改善晶片性能並減少訊號干擾 
隨晶片堆疊層數增加，為了將電力從封裝傳輸至晶片中的晶體管，電子必須經由金屬導線和通孔，
穿過 10-20 層堆疊才能為下方電晶體提供電源和數據訊號，然而越接近晶體管，寬線和通孔就越窄，
電阻值因而上升，使電子在向下傳輸的過程，出現 IR 壓降現象，導致電力損失產生，此外電源線
在佈線複雜的後段製程中 (BEOL)，占用至少 20%的繞線資源，因此 晶背供電 (Backside Power 
Delivery Network ；BSPDN)將線路轉移至晶片背面，緩解 IR 降壓並大幅改善晶片性能，幫助邏輯
晶片持續微縮，也使下層金屬層間距更為寬鬆，減少 EUV 光刻次數，進而降低成本。 
晶圓代工大廠如 Intel 宣布於 2024 年量產的 20A (2nm) 晶片開始導入晶背供電技術(Powervia)，為
客戶提供晶背供電技術服務；台積電則宣布於 2026 年量產的 N2P 製程採用晶背供電技術，將性能
提高 10-12%，並將晶片面積減少 10-15%；三星則是預計於 2027 年將晶背供電技術用於 1.4nm
製程。 
*IR 降壓：系統級電路中電壓下降和升高的一種表現，電壓提供不足或超過都會造成晶片無法正常
運行。

獲利調整與股票評價
維持買進、目標本益比 40 倍、以 2027 年 EPS，目標價升至 840 元
元大最新預估中砂 2026/27 年 EPS 分別為 14.23/20.85 元，分別上修 7%/11%，基於近幾季毛利
率表現優於預期，主要來自產品組合改善，包括先進製程佔比提升及本身毛利率進一步提高、再生
晶圓產能擴充且以高階產品為主及 ABU 復甦及子公司合併綜效顯現等，使得毛利率優於我們先前
預估 2~3 個百分點。展望 2026 年主要動能來自 N2 佔比更為提升、美系 IDM 量進一步擴大，鑽石
碟由 25 年底月產能 5 萬片增加至 26 年年底將達 7 萬片以上、再生晶圓新增 7 萬片產能提前至
2Q26 投產，加上完整認列 MKS、MGT 營收，估計營收 YoY 成長 25%。根據大客戶 N2 產能規劃，
25 年近 3 萬片，估計 26 年達 9~10 萬片，27 年有機會達 15~20 萬片，因而預估 27 年鑽石碟營收

YoY 成長 4 成，佔比提升至 38%，毛利率可望提升至近 60%。中長期仍看好公司的鑽石碟、再生
晶圓皆可望受惠更先進製程帶動內容價值提升、需求的成長趨勢不變。
整體而言 2026-2027 年營運展望更趨樂觀，主要成長來自 AI/HPC/車用新興應用帶動半導體新材料
的開發及內容價值提升、新產能挹注營運動能更為強勁，另外，美系 IDM 廠為新動能，惟目前挹
注不大。根據 2026/27 年預估獲利換算本益比為 52/36 倍，落於歷史區間 15-45 倍之中上緣，高於
國內同業平均本益比 34/25 倍，係反映市場看好 2026-2027 年先進製程趨勢推升公司中長期營運動
能，主要成長來自內容價值、市佔率提升及公司為少數有機會受惠 N2/晶背供電技術之廠商。本中
心維持買進評等，目標本益比 40 倍、以 2027 年 EPS 得出目標價 840 元，反映主力客戶先進製程
展望佳，帶動未來二年獲利成長優於過往水準及市場預期，評價面亦有提升空間。

► ESG 總分： 中砂整體的 ESG 風險評級屬於中度風險，於 Sustainalytics 資料庫所覆蓋的公司中排名亦排行於略為落後
的位置，但在機械設備行業中排名略為領先同業。 
► 在 ESG 議題上的曝險： 中砂的整體曝險屬於中等水準，與機械設備行業的平均水準相當。公司較需要改善的 ESG 議
題包含人力資本、產品管理及商業道德等。 
► 個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力：中砂的整體曝險屬於中等水準，與機械設備行業的平均水準相當。公司較需要改善

### Page 1

Macquarie Equity Research
18 September 2026
Technology
Alchip Technologies
Growth acceleration under way
Key Points
• Alchip's 3nm AI ASIC project ramped in 2Q26 and has driven strong
HoH and YoY growth from 2H26.
• We believe the 3nm AI ASIC ramp-up and next-generation tape-out in
late-2026 are key catalysts for Alchip shares.
• While we do not forecast additional CSP projects, the company is
"highly confident" it can secure another major CSP customer.
Expect 100%+ sales CAGR in 2026/27
• We believe share-price upside could be driven by: 1) the successful
ramp of its key customer’s 3nm AI ASIC (shipments from June), 2)
success in winning the key customer’s next-generation projects (tape
out in late-2026), and 3) other key projects, including networking-related
projects that could help drive 2027 and beyond sales growth, along with
multiple ADAS projects (the first major project ramped up in 1Q26).
• We maintain our positive long-term view on ASIC industry growth,
driven by the continued outsourcing of IC design services to Asia,
supported by a large talent pool and lower costs, and by Alchip's strong
competitive position and track record. We are not concerned about
Alchip's key customer's agreements with other semiconductor peers.
We believe these agreements highlight the large, growing TAM for the
customer's AI ASIC and related ecosystem. We also note that Alchip's
largest customer has invested in Alchip stock twice.
• Company remains bullish through at least 2029: During its 2Q26
analyst meeting in August, the company reiterated that sales should be
"at least in line with AI ASIC industry growth through 2029." The company
also expressed confidence in 3nm AI ASIC sales from June 2026 and in
the successful tape-out of its next-generation AI ASIC project before
year-end.
Earnings changes: We raise our 2026E/2027E/2028E EPS rep by
9%/27%/20% to reflect the higher scale of AI ASIC projects.
Valuation: We raise our target price 4% to NT$6,784, based on a 26x 2028E
PER, from NT$6,542, based on a 30x 2028E PER. Our new multiple is back in
line with the historical average and to reflect high customer concentration.
Catalysts: Sustained revenue growth from June; successful tape-out of a
next-generation project in 2H26.
Investment Thesis and Recommendation
As a key AI beneficiary with a strong track record of successful leading-
edge project ramps, we continue to believe in Alchip's long-term growth
outlook and remain positive on AI ASIC industry growth. Link to prior
Alchip research.

### Page 2

Macquarie Equity Research Alchip Technologies
Key Risks to Investment Thesis
• Project ramp-up delays or failure to reach mass production,
resulting in lower-than-expected scale.
• Order reductions from key customers, including potential
impacts from US semiconductor regulations, leading to
sales or earnings misses.
• Failure to secure key customers' next-generation projects.
Company Description
Alchip is a IC design service companies that assists IC design

and system companies to complete chip designs. Their
revenues come in two main streams: 1) NRE (non-recurring
engineering) which is the service provided starting with the
back-end design of the semiconductor to tape out at foundry.
2) Turnkey occurs when Alchip assists customers in placing
wafer orders to foundries (TSMC) and delivering final wafers to
customers.

伺服器與記憶體雙刀流   
◼ 結 論 與 建 議 
毛利率與營益率同步創高，核心動能來自高階產品比重提升與折舊負擔下
降，中長期則受惠高階 PCB 需求成長與產品組合優化。預估健鼎 (3044 
T T)2026 年 EPS  31.01 元， 2027 年 隨 湖 北 、 越 南 產 能 開 出 ， 月產能朝 100
億 元 以 上 推 進 ， 支 撐 營 收 持 續 成 長，EPS 38.48 元， 建 議 給 予 本 益 比 17 倍，
設定目標價 654 元（ 17X ＊ 2027(F )） ， 評 等 「 買 進 」 。

◼ 重點摘要  
AI HP C 趨勢 帶 動 新 型 記 憶 體 架 構 需 求  
PCB 過 去 主 要 成 長 動 能 來 自 手 機 等 消 費 性 電 子 ， 但 隨 AI 與 資 料 中 心 需 求 興
起 ， 伺 服 器 、 網 通 與 高 速 運 算 應 用 成 為 重 要 支 撐 。 隨 平 台 升 級 （ 如 DD R5 、
PCIe Gen5 ） 帶 動 資 料 傳 輸 速 度 提 升 ， 對 高 多 層 板 與 部 分 HDI 產 品 的 需 求
同 步 增 加 ， 產 品 規 格 與 層 數 亦 持 續 提 升 。 此 外 ， 高 階 應 用 比 重 提 升 有 助 於
產 品 組 合 優 化 ， 帶 動 單 價 與 附 加 價 值 提 升 ； 同 時 ， 隨 系 統 架 構 與 高 速 傳 輸
需 求 演 進 ， PCB 在 系 統 中 的 重 要 性 持 續 提 高 。 整 體 而 言 ， 高 多 層 板 為 主 要
成 長 動 能 ， HDI 則 在 特 定 應 用 中 維 持 穩 定 需 求 。 另 在 低 軌 衛 星 等 新 興 應 用
中 ， 對 高 可 靠 度 與 高 密 度 板 需 求 逐 步 提 升 ， 也 帶 來 潛 在 發 展 機 會 。

公 司 簡 介 ─ 全 球 前 十 大 P CB 廠 之 一  
健鼎科技初期主要從事 POS 系 統 之 產 銷 及 週 邊 設 計 ， 1996 年 成 立 印 刷 電 路
板（ PCB ）事 業 部 後 逐 步 轉 型 為 專 業 PCB 製 造 廠 。 主 要 產 品 為 雙 面 板 與 多 層
板 ， 終 端 應 用 涵 蓋 記 憶 體 模 組 、 薄 膜 電 晶 體 液 晶 顯 示 器 （ TFT -LCD ）、硬
碟、伺服器 / 工作 站 、 汽 車 電 子 、 筆 記 型 電 腦 及 行 動 電 話 等 多 元 領 域 。 PCB
作為電子零組件連接與訊號 傳輸的核心載體，依層數區分為單 層板、雙層
板與多層板，其中多層板為公司主要產品線。原物料包括基板、銅箔、樹
脂、金鹽、乾膜、磷銅球與油墨等化學材料。 生 產 據 點 涵 蓋 台 灣 平 鎮 廠 ，
以 及 中 國 江 蘇 無 錫 I 、 II 廠與湖北仙桃廠，並持續推進越南邊和廠布局。

Ser ver 與 Module 出 貨 增 加  
健鼎 2Q2026 營收 248.6 億元， QoQ +18.6% ， YoY +38.8% ，毛利率
30.1% ， QoQ +3.6ppts ， YoY +3.9ppts ，營益率 22.5% ， QoQ 
+4.1ppts ， YoY +4.5ppts ， EPS 7.41 元 。 毛 利 率 改 善 主 要 來 自 產 品 組 合 優
化 、 營 收 放 大 與 折 舊 率 下降 。 預估 健鼎 3Q2026 營收 302.9 億 元 ， QoQ 
+21.8% ， YoY +56.2% ， 毛 利 率 30.3% ， QoQ +0.2ppts ， YoY +3.5ppts ，
營益率 22.7% ， QoQ +0.2ppts ， YoY +4.1ppts ， EPS 9.14 元。 3Q26 營收
維持成長，主要受惠 Ser ver 與 Module 出 貨 增 加 ； 毛 利 率 有 望 維 持 30% 以
上 ， 費 用 率 控 制 於 8.0% 左右，全年營收挑戰 1,000 億元。

表二 、 全球 PCB 製 造 產 值 與成長 趨勢

資料 來源 ： 公 司 ， 康 和 投 顧 整 理 。

客戶涵蓋歐美及亞洲大型客戶  
公 司 客 戶 涵 蓋 國 際 一 線 品 牌 與 系 統 廠 ， 應 用 橫 跨 記 憶 體 模 組 （ DDR4 、
DDR5 ）、 硬 碟 、 筆 記 型 電 腦 、 光 電 板 、 手 機 、 AI 伺服器與車電等領域；目
前 產 品 組 合 以 Ser ver 為 主 ， 占 營 收 約 42% ， 其 次 為 DRAM/SSD 23% 、
Automotive 16% 等 ，隨 Ser ver 與 Modul e 需求持續成長， 2H26 兩 者 合 計
營 收 占 比 可 望 超 過 70% ， 帶 動 高 階 多 層 板 與 高 可 靠 度 產 品 出 貨 提 升 。 此
外，公司深耕車用、伺服器與工業等高可靠度應用，具 規模與製造優勢 。

強化高階板比重  
2026 持 續 擴 充 湖 北 、 越 南 產 能 ， 1H26 資 本 支 出 約 71.9 億 元 ， 全 年 規 劃 約
150 億 元 ， 越 南 新 廠 預 計 4Q26 小量量 產； 2027 年 月 產 能 朝 100 億元以上
發展，全年營收挑戰 1,200 億元 。產品端以 General Ser ver 大量出貨為基
礎，逐 步 提 升 AI 與 高 階 HDI 比 重，目 前 Ser ver 中約 10 ～ 15% 為 AI 相 關 板、
約 10% 為 HDI 產 品 ， 已 具 二 、 三 階 HDI 製 程 能 力 。

地緣政治與供應鏈重組，需求穩健復甦  
公司產能以中國無錫與湖北為核心，越南為擴產與分散地緣風險據點 ，其中
周德新廠 2026 年 第 一 季 試 產 ， 月 產 能 約 30 萬 呎，以 NB 與 伺 服 器 板 為 主 。
在地緣政治與供應鏈重組趨勢下，客戶對於生產基地多元化的需求提升 ，公
司亦配合客戶需求進行海外產能布局。 全球 PCB 產業仍以中國為主要生產
基 地 （ 市 占 56% 至 57% ） ， 中 國 廠 商 （ 如 勝 宏 ） 持 續 擴 產 下 ， 不 過 ， 同 時 供
應鏈外移趨勢延續，泰國與越南將成為後續產能布局重點。

欣銓 (3264 TT)  Buy

晶圓大廠新訂單逐步向上，建議 Buy。  
投資建議 ：欣銓 2026 年資本支出轉向積極擴張，主要來自與策
略客戶已確定之 ASIC 合作案。欣銓 1H26 在取得不動產、廠房
及設備的現金流出達新台幣 70.07 億元，較 1H25 的 18.65 億元
大幅增加約 51.4 億元。預期 2H26 則隨龍潭廠機台陸續交付並
完成數據驗證後，進入產能爬坡期，營收逐步向上。在排除匯
率波動前提下 ， 獲利亦預計維持逐季成長的趨勢 。 預估欣銓2026
年稅後 EPS 9.94 元。龍潭廠新專案是 2026~2027 年最重要的增
長引擎 。 公司與策略夥伴(晶圓廠 )合作的 ASIC 測試專案 07/2026
開始明顯增加，而旗下全智湖口新廠，也於 3Q26 正式進入矽光
子相關新產品的量產階段，都將帶動公司中長期營收獲利向上，
因此建議欣銓 Buy ，目標價 322 元 (2027 年 PER24X) 。  
2Q26 稅後 EPS 2.36 元： AI 相關需求佳和通訊相關訂單維持強
勁。欣銓 2Q26 營收為 45.34 億元， QoQ+13.81% 。營收依應用
別分析，通訊 Communication/Connectivity 佔 33.4% ；車用 /安控
(ATV/Security) 佔 18.2% ；射頻晶片 (RF IC) 佔 12.2% ；微處理器
(General MCU) 佔 8.5% ； Storage 佔 10.8% ； PC/Consumers 佔
9.9% ；Memory 佔 5.4% ；其他 1.6% 。毛利率的部份， 2Q26 毛利
率為 40.17% ，增加 1.81 個百分點。 2Q26 稅後 EPS 2.36 元。  
預估 3Q26 稅後 EPS 2.73 元：龍潭新廠歷經 1H26 客戶驗證與
進場裝機後，已於 07/2026 起正式進入量產階段，帶動欣銓
08/2026 營收增加至 17.94 億元， MoM+1.57% ， YoY+46.57% 。
此廠區主要與晶圓代工廠 (Foundry) 合作，針對  AI ASIC 提供
測試服務。這批高階機台目前的稼動率極高，幾乎處於滿載狀
態，其量產將顯著貢獻 3Q26 營收，也會讓晶圓代工業務的營收
佔比在 3Q26 逐漸放大。此外，在傳統應用領域如車用 IC 及  
General MCU 方面 ， 由於客戶端在疫後的庫存已降至合理水位 ，
需求正逐步回升。預估 3Q26 稅後 EPS 2.73 元。

【投資評等調整機制】  
  投資評等係「首次」給予特定個股投資評等時，其前一日收盤價相較 3 個月
目標價之潛在上漲空間計算而得。個股投資評等分為四個等級，定義如上。
爾後的投資評等係依循「首次評等」，直到停止推薦。   
「強力買進」、「買進」及「區間操作」均有 upside 目標價。差別僅在於，
首次評等時潛在報酬率不同。「中立」則無目標價。  
一旦我們給予特定個股「強力買進」 、 「買進」或「區間操作」之投資評等，
就是責任的開始，爾後將透過各式研究報告作定期性、持續性追蹤基本面及
股價變化，直到停止推薦。  
停止推薦情境：  
1.  達目標價。  
2.  雖未達原訂目標價，但檢視基本面、訊息面、籌碼面等多方訊息，研
判股價上漲空間已然有限，將適時出具降評報告。  
3.  推薦後股價不漲反跌。

3Q26 營收及獲利表現強勁 
3Q26 進入旺季，板卡業務復甦，Server 料源轉好，遞延訂單開始出貨，估
營收季增 55%至 156億元，年增 34%。低毛利率 AI Server出貨較多，估毛
利率季減 3百分點至 17%，營業利益 15.3億元，季增 66%，年增 145%。
估稅後 7億元，季增 93%，年增 31%，EPS 5.7元，比原先預估上修 19%，
主因高毛利率一般型 Server 比重上升及 PC 相關產品(MB、VGA)業績谷底
翻揚，造成毛利率及本業獲利比原先預期佳。 
記憶體大漲，但客戶殺價情況減緩，反而有助整體毛利率上升 
公司終端產品漲價減低記憶體大漲影響，客戶殺價情況亦減緩，有助整體毛
利率上升，1Q/2Q26毛利率 15%/20%，遠比 2025年 13.6%佳。下半年 AI 
Server料源逐漸改善，占比上升，估華擎 3Q/4Q26降至 17.0%/15.8%，但
全年毛利率 16.7%，年增 3.1百分點。2027年受 AI Server GB系列開始出
貨，毛利率降至 15.5%，年減 1.2百分點，但營收規模擴大，費用率下滑，
估 2026/27年營業利益率 8.9%/8.3%，比 2025年 5.7%佳。 
2026/27 年營收及獲利維持 20%以上高成長 
2026/27年受惠資料中心建置加快，企業端推論需求提高，估一般型 Server
營收成長 73%/18%。2026/27 年北美、亞洲等 新客戶訂單增加， 估 AI 
Server 營收成長 57%/43%(占整體營收比重 51.1%/56.7%)。合計 2026/27
年整體 Server營收(一般型+AI)年增 61%/37%，占比 70%/74%。 
合計華擎 2026/27年營收年增 20%/29%至 574/743億元(2026年下修 4%，
主因 AI Server 缺料)，估 2026/27 年毛利率 16.7%/15.5%，比 2025 年
13.55%改善。合計稅後 23.5/29.5億元，年增 24%/26%，EPS 1 8.98/23.87
元，比先前預估略下修 1%/1%，主因少數股權項目扣除變多 。受惠 AI 
Server需求高，工業電腦明顯復甦，華擎獲利表現仍佳，維持買進評等。

記憶體短缺且價格大漲，客戶殺價情況亦減緩，反而有助整體毛利率上升 
1Q26記憶體大漲，華擎與客戶合作因應，VGA/Server相關產品向客戶動態報價，客戶自行採買更
便宜記憶體或減少記憶體配置量，降低影響； IPC 則因記憶體配備無法輕易變動，較難如 Server
採減少配置作法，對價格敏感的客戶會遞延拉貨。需求部分，MB 出貨雖未配備 DRAM，但終端產
品漲價，消費性電子客戶較難適應，出貨下滑；其餘產品銷售亦受波及，但比 MB影響略小。 
公司終端產品漲價減低記憶體大漲影響， 且記憶體、 CPU、GPU 料源不足，造成低毛利率 AI 
Server出貨不順，客戶殺價情況亦減緩，反而有助整體毛利率上升，1Q/2Q26毛利率 15%/20%，
遠比 2025 年 13.6%佳。下半年 AI Server 料源逐漸改善，占比上升，因此估華擎 3Q/4Q26 降至
17.0%/15.8%，但全年毛利率 16.7%，年增 3.1百分點。2027年受 AI Server GB系列開始出貨，
毛利率降至 15.5%，年減 1.2 百分點，但營收規模擴大，費用率下滑，估 2026/27 年營業利益率
8.9%/8.3%，遠比 2025年 5.7%佳。

圖 9：全球電競 NB 出貨量預估

資料來源：IDC、元大投顧預估 
AI、ASIC、通用型強勢出擊，2026 年美系 CSP 資本支出估年增 91%  
在 ChatGPT 等 AI 應用陸續推向市場，各大業者紛紛開始研發自有超級大模型，包括 Gemini 
(Google)、Claude (Anthropic)、Llama (Meta) 等，各大品牌開始大舉投入大型語言模型(LLM)市場，
且每一個產品的智慧皆持續提高，部分消費者也陸續從 ChatGPT 陣營轉移至 Gemini 陣營，反映
出消費者開始逐漸提升對 AI的黏著度。根據 Grand View Research 調查，2024 年全球 AI 市場營
收預估約 2,792 億美元，預估 2030 年市場規模超過 3 兆美元，擁有超過 30% 的年複合增長率。 
面對這爆發性的長期成長趨勢，CSP業者(Amazon、Microsoft、Google、Meta)在法說會上一致強
調，AI投資已轉變為一項橫跨 2026 年的結構性戰略，CSP大廠不僅持續擴大對 GB300等次世代
AI 伺服器的採購，更將重點放在資料中心基礎設施的長期戰略規劃，以應對 AI 運算對電力及散熱
系統強勁成長的需求，確保未來數年內擁有足夠的能源與容量來支持持續迭代的大模型部署。本中
心認為，2026年美國四大 CSP資本支出將年增 91%，且將有一半的成長來自於資料中心建置，代
表了資料中心的不足及未來伺服器需求。明年不僅僅是 NVIDIA GB300 的天下，AWS、Google、
Meta ASIC的崛起也將是一大關鍵，其中又以 Google TPU需求最為強勁，已經有兩個客戶預計將
採購 TPU。 
另外，受惠於 AI訓練與推論需求爆發的連帶效應，本中心預估 2026年通用型伺服器出貨量將年增
23%，其中以存儲型伺服器需求最為強勁。隨著生成式 AI 應用普及和使用者數量暴增，CSP 等業
者必須不斷擴充容量，且不僅限於高階 GPU 伺服器，龐大的 AI模型訓練和推論在使用狀態中將消
耗大量的數據(DATA)，使得存儲型伺服器的需求大增。

公司簡介  
華擎成立於 2002年 5月，原為華碩子公司，以銷售中、低階主機板為主，後跨入工業電腦、伺服器等領域。後來華碩、和
碩分割後，華擎成為和碩子公司。產品組合(2025年)：主機板 20%、工業電腦 4%、一般伺服器 13%、AI伺服器 39%、其
他 24%。旗下設二家子公司，分別為永擎(持股 60%；主攻伺服器)、東擎(持股 64%；主打工業電腦)。華擎未設工廠，產
品主要交由和碩及陸商(中國、越南設廠)代工。公司未來發展以非 PC產品為主，有助分散營運風險。

ESG 分析  
分別藉由「在 ESG議題上的曝險」和「個別公司在 ESG議題上的執行力」兩個面向來衡量公司於 ESG上的表現。 
► ESG 總分： 華擎整體的 ESG風險評級屬於中風險，於 Sustainalytics資料庫所覆蓋的公司中排名位於中間位置，在科
技硬體行業的公司中排名則略為落後同業。 
► 在 ESG 議題上的曝險： 華擎的整體曝險屬於低水準，且略優於科技硬體行業的平均水準。公司較需要改善的  ESG 議
題包含商業道德、人力資源和公司的數據安全等。 
► 個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力：華擎在針對重大 ESG議題的管理水準和執行力屬中等，已採取若干措施來管理與實
質 ESG議題相關的風險，公司擁有完整對 ESG的揭露，包含成立永續發展辦公室及發布 CSR報告書等，展現了對企
業社會責任的實踐。但在關鍵領域如職場多元性、供應鏈管理仍缺乏相應的政策與計畫。儘管如此，該公司並未捲入具
有重大財務影響的風險事件。
